subject: Re: Vanguard private deployment - deployability assurance & clarifications
messages:
From: Alice Burns <alice.burns@vanguard.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Li <ryan.li@vanguard.com>, Procurement <procurement@vanguard.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Vanguard private deployment - initial questions

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's runtime and the private deployment options. As we move this into our vendor assessment queue I need a few clarifications to close the internal deployability checklist:

- Can you confirm whether the on-prem package supports a fully air-gapped install (no outbound egress during install or runtime)? If so, what are the exact artifacts we need to bring on-prem (OS image, packages, license token format)?
- How does KMS/HSM integration work? Do you support customer-controlled HSM (KMIP) or only cloud KMS integrations?
- What is the upgrade story for air-gapped clusters (patching/rollback)? Is there an offline upgrade bundle?
- Please provide a high-level network topology for a typical single-region private deployment and the minimum ports/hosts that must be accessible.
- Do you provide an attestation or installation witness for SOC2 controls relevant to on-prem deployments (access logs, change logs)?

Attached is our standard MMP (managed marketplace procurement) checklist — please return the relevant sections filled where applicable. Procurement will also want a statement on support SLAs for private installs and contact / escalation paths.

Best,
Alice
Alice Burns
Sr. Engineering Program Manager — Infrastructure Security
Vanguard

[Attachment: Vanguard_MMP_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Burns <alice.burns@vanguard.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vanguard private deployment - initial questions

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (deployments) and Neha (security/compliance) to provide the detailed artifacts. Quick answers up front so procurement has something to work with:

- Air-gapped installs: Yes, Redwood supports fully air-gapped private deployments. We provide an offline installer bundle and checksums; no runtime outbound egress is required if you opt into local model storage and disable telemetry.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-controlled HSM via KMIP and on-prem HSMs (YubiHSM / Thales) for key custody; we also support Bring-Your-Own-KMS integrations for major cloud providers in dedicated/private cloud modes.
- Upgrades: We publish offline upgrade bundles with pre-computed diffs; upgrades are orchestrated through our CLI with built-in rollback checkpoints.
- Network/topology: attaching an example topology and the minimal port list.
- Attestation: We can provide a SOC2 summary and change-log export for the private deployment; Neha will enumerate the exact artifacts and formats.

Next steps: Marissa and Neha, can you attach the offline installer checklist, network diagram, and the SOC2 summary we can share with Vanguard? Alice, once you review the attachments let's schedule a 60-minute install walkthrough with your infra team.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_airgap_install_guide_v1.pdf (pdf), network_topology_example.svg (svg)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Burns <alice.burns@vanguard.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 14:23:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vanguard private deployment - initial questions — technical deep dive

Hi Alice — attaching the technical artifacts you requested and a short explanation for each item. Happy to walk through any section in the install walkthrough.

Attachments included in this message:
- redwood_airgap_install_guide_v1.pdf — offline installer steps, required host packages, expected install time (single-region 3-node pilot: ~2–4 hours for base runtime, model sync additional time depending on model size).
- network_topology_example.svg — shows control plane, inference nodes, optional metrics collector, and minimal port/host matrix.
- soc2_summary_redwood_2026.pdf — extracts of controls most relevant to private deployments (logging, access reviews, change control).

Key technical notes:
- Offline bundle: delivered as a signed tarball with SHA256 checksums. Install CLI verifies signatures against a customer-provided public key (we support both RSA and ECDSA).
- Model sync: for air-gapped installs you may either seed models via USB / internal registry pull from a staging host, or we can provide a sealed model archive delivered through your secure transfer process.
- KMS/HSM: we support KMIP over TLS for HSM integration. Root keys remain in customer HSM. Key wrapping is performed inside the HSM; Redwood never has access to unwrapped root keys.
- Telemetry: default telemetry is disabled for air-gapped installs. When enabled in dedicated/private modes, telemetry endpoints are configurable and can be routed to a customer-side collector.
- Patching: offline upgrade bundles include an orchestrated preflight check, staged rollout by node role, and automated rollback markers.

Open questions we still have for Vanguard (to confirm during walkthrough):
- Preferred model transfer mechanism (secure drive vs. internal registry pull)
- Acceptance criteria for successful pilot (latency targets, throughput, uptime window)

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_airgap_install_guide_v1.pdf (pdf), network_topology_example.svg (svg), soc2_summary_redwood_2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alice Burns <alice.burns@vanguard.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Li <ryan.li@vanguard.com>, Procurement <procurement@vanguard.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vanguard private deployment - initial questions — follow ups

Markus / Marissa — thanks for those artifacts, very helpful. A few follow-ups from our security and procurement teams:

- SOC2 evidence: procurement will need the SOC2 report PDF and a point-of-contact for follow-up questions from your compliance team. The summary is helpful but we need the report and a redaction statement if necessary.
- KMS custody: our security lead wants confirmation that in the KMIP integration flow, Vanguard retains sole custody of unwrapped keys and that Redwood never holds unwrapped key material (we need that in writing).
- SLA / Support: procurement asked for the private deployment support SLA (response & severity timelines) and on-call escalation matrix for production incidents.
- Timeline: procurement is targeting a PO by end of January; can you confirm Redwood's availability for an on-prem pilot starting week of Jan 18?

For procurement reference I attached their standard PO timeline and checklist. Looking forward to the install walkthrough — please propose 2 windows next week.

Thanks,
Alice

[Attachment: Procurement_PO_Timeline.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Burns <alice.burns@vanguard.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vanguard private deployment - deployability assurance & clarifications

Alice — thank you and Vanguard team for the thoughtful questions. Below is a concise assurance summary we can include in the procurement packet; Marissa and Neha are copied for technical verification and to provide any additional artifacts.

Redwood deployability assurance (summary):
- Air-gapped install: Redwood provides a signed offline installer bundle (SHA256) and an install verification CLI. No outbound egress is required after installation when customer config disables telemetry. Evidence: "redwood_airgap_install_guide_v1.pdf" (attached).
- KMS/HSM custodial control: Vanguard retains sole custody of unwrapped keys. We support KMIP-based HSM integrations and attest that key wrapping/unwrapping occurs within the customer's HSM. Redwood only stores wrapped keys and key handles. (Formal attestation available upon NDA/PO request.)
- SOC2 evidence: We can provide the unredacted SOC2 report under our standard evidence-sharing NDA (or via secure portal). A redacted summary is included in "soc2_summary_redwood_2026.pdf". Compliance POC: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai).
- Support SLA (private deployments): Standard private support tiers include 24x7 incident intake with 1-hour critical response, 4-hour high, and next-business-day medium. On-call escalation matrix (names and cell numbers) will be provided in the formal procurement addendum.
- Upgrade & rollback: Offline upgrade bundles with preflight checks and rollback markers. We recommend a staged pilot (3-node) followed by a controlled rollout to production.

Next steps / proposed dates:
- Install walkthrough: Jan 5 or Jan 7 (60 minutes) — please confirm preferred slot.
- Pilot start: week of Jan 18 subject to PO and access.
- Evidence transfer: we will upload SOC2 to a secure drive and can provide a DocuSign-secured attestation for signature.

DocuSign & procurement: To accelerate the procurement timeline, I am sending the MSA addendum and pilot SOW for signature (DocuSign link below). Once countersigned we will schedule the onboarding kickoff and reserve engineering capacity.

DocuSign (MSA addendum + SOW): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?token=eyJv...
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
Secure drive (artifacts folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF_vanguard-share

If you prefer a short call to run the attestation language live, Neha and I are available tomorrow afternoon.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
